name: find_extreme_locations
description: Find the highest, lowest, or top-percentile locations in a climate, hazard, risk, threshold, or other spatial layer. The function can rank an already-loaded artifact or load a registered climate layer internally.

input_artifact.description: Optional already-loaded or clipped spatial artifact containing GeoJSON features and a numeric value column.

variable.description: Climate, hazard, or risk variable to rank. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index', 'risk_score'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

region_name.description: Region to analyze. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

period.description: Projection period. Examples: '2050s', '2060s', '2100s'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

value_column.description: Optional numeric column used to rank extreme locations. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifact.

direction.description: Whether to find the highest or lowest values. Supported examples: 'highest', 'lowest', 'top', 'bottom', 'max', 'min', 'hottest', 'worst'.

selection_method.description: How to select extreme locations. Supported values: 'top_n' or 'percentile'. If omitted, the function uses 'percentile' when percentile is provided, otherwise 'top_n'.

top_n.description: Number of locations to return when selection_method is 'top_n'.

percentile.description: Percentile cutoff when selection_method is 'percentile'. Accepts either 95 or 0.95.

clip_to_region.description: Whether to clip the layer to the requested region before ranking extreme locations.

region_artifact.description: Optional resolved region artifact from resolve_region. Used for clipping if clip_to_region is true.

include_full_input.description: Whether to include a ranked GeoJSON version of the full valid input layer in the output.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input that was ranked.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the extreme-locations output.

variable.description: Climate, hazard, or risk variable analyzed.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

source_value_column.description: Original numeric column used for ranking.

top_n.description: Number of locations selected if using top_n.

percentile.description: Percentile used if using percentile selection.

percentile_threshold.description: Numeric threshold implied by the percentile selection.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing selected extreme locations.

full_input_geojson.description: Optional ranked GeoJSON FeatureCollection for the full valid input layer.

input_feature_count.description: Number of input features before ranking.

valid_count.description: Number of features with valid numeric values.

missing_count.description: Number of features with missing or non-numeric values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Summary statistics for the input layer and selected extreme locations.

table.description: Table-friendly ranked output with rank, value, longitude, and latitude.

provenance.description: Information about ranking method, clipping, and parent artifact.
